personality_one_liner: Trustworthy, clean, and medical with soothing green and blue accents built on a soft neutral foundation for maximum clarity.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly dont have extra spaces where its not required, handle padding and margin corectly and subtle for buttons and components

do's: Apply to bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it
Apply to sticky headers over scrolling content
Apply to floating action buttons over tinted background
dont's: Do not apply to form fields or list rows
Do not use if it hurts text readability; use tinted base underneath

screens.name: Splash & Role Select

states.loading: Subtle green spinner with clinic logo

screens.layout: Full-bleed background using abstract green medical backdrop with dark gradient scrim. Clean, full-width pill buttons for 'I am a Patient' and 'I am a Doctor' anchored at bottom.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Authenticate user via Phone/OTP or Google.

states.loading: Input disabled, CTA shows loading state

screens.layout: Clean white surface with large typography for trust. Single column form, labels above inputs, phone number entry with floating sticky CTA at the bottom. 'Continue with Google' as secondary action.

screens.name: Patient Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard for patients to view upcoming visits and quick actions.

states.loading: Skeleton loader for upcoming appointment card and doctors list
states.empty: Illustration of medical clipboard with 'No upcoming appointments'
states.error: Failed to load data with retry button

screens.layout: Header with 'Hello, [Name]' and UHID badge. Top section: Featured 'Upcoming Appointment' card (glassmorphism effect if image behind). Middle: 2-column grid for quick actions (Book, Upload, Services). Bottom: Horizontal scroll list of Doctors from clinic.

screens.name: Book Appointment

states.loading: Spinner over calendar when fetching available slots
states.empty: No slots available on selected day

screens.layout: Progress indicator at top. Calendar view with touch-friendly date cells, followed by a grid of time slots as selectable chips. Sticky primary CTA 'Confirm Booking' at bottom.

screens.name: Upload Records
screens.purpose: Patient tool to upload prescriptions and test results.

states.empty: Empty state illustration of a folder for 'No files uploaded yet'

screens.layout: Large dashed-border dropzone area for 'Tap to upload (Camera/Gallery/PDF)'. Below it, a list of recently uploaded files with status indicators (Pending Review, Reviewed).

screens.name: My Appointments (Patient)
screens.purpose: List of past and upcoming appointments.
screens.layout: Segmented control at top (Upcoming / Past). Clean vertical list of appointment cards showing Date, Doctor, Status (e.g., green 'Confirmed', blue 'Consultation Notes Ready').

screens.name: Doctor Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of today's queue and patients for the doctor.
screens.layout: Summary metrics at top (e.g., 12 Waiting, 4 Completed). Vertical list of patient cards containing Name, Time, UHID, and a quick action to 'View Details' or 'Start Consult'.

screens.name: Patient Detail & Consultation (Doctor View)
screens.purpose: Doctor views patient history, uploaded files, and adds notes.
screens.layout: Header with patient info and UHID. Tabbed view or stacked sections: 'Medical History', 'Uploaded Files (Grid view)', and a text area section to 'Add Consultation Notes / Reply'. Sticky CTA 'Save Notes'.

pills_abstract.alt: Green and white pills on blue background

instructions_to_main_agent: Use '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality to ensure a trustworthy, clinical, and highly readable interface.
Implement the green (`#059669`) and blue (`#2563EB`) accent theme strictly as per the user choices, overriding the default ban on blue since it was explicitly requested.
Ensure all primary call-to-action buttons (like 'Confirm Booking' or 'Login') use `brandPrimary` (green) and are anchored via a sticky bottom container over scrolling content.
The Patient Home should prominently display the patient's generated UHID (Unique Health ID) at the top, perhaps as a `brandTertiary` tinted badge.
For the doctor's side, prioritize list scanning efficiency. Queue cards should have strong typographic hierarchy distinguishing Time, Name, and Status.
When placing text over the 'medical_abstract_bg' image (e.g., on Splash screen), ALWAYS apply the vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to guarantee WCAG contrast.
Use `Ionicons` consistently. Active tabs should use filled versions, while inactive tabs use outlined versions.
Follow iOS-native spacing rhythms: use generous padding (`lg` or `xl` for screen edges) and group related data with `md` gap.
Implement glassmorphism (`expo-blur`) for the bottom tab bar and sticky headers to provide elevated, premium feel.
